# Soumik Mondal (asksoumik)

> Soumik Mondal, also known as asksoumik, is a CSE student in India and AI builder. He builds AI products that remove friction (voice-first RAG, handwriting-to-font, developer kits) and brings a basic UI/UX design sense to them. Open to founding-team projects.

Not to be confused with other people named Mondal or Soumik. This is the AI builder and student developer whose handle is asksoumik.
